dosageInstruction.text: Anti-platelets shuru karein: Aspirin loading dose 325 mg followed by 75 mg OD, aur Clopidogrel loading dose 300 mg followed by 75 mg OD (ICMR STW page 1, 3).

medicationCodeableConcept.text: Anti thrombotics: Enoxaparin 1 mg/Kg SC 12 hrly ya Unfractionated heparin bolus

dosageInstruction.text: Anti thrombotics: Enoxaparin 1 mg/Kg SC 12 hrly ya Unfractionated heparin bolus 60 U/Kg (max 5000 U) followed by 12 U/Kg hourly infusion to maintain APTT 50-70 sec (ICMR STW page 1, 3).

dosageInstruction.text: Risk category (TIMI score) calculate karein: Age >65 (patient 45 hai, so 0), >3 risk factors (diabetes hai, aur BP high hai, so possible), known CAD (unknown), recurrence in 24 hrs (unknown), aspirin use in 7 days (unknown), ST deviation >0.5 mV (ECG ke baad pata chalega), raised cardiac markers (troponin elevated hai) (ICMR STW page 4).
